native-budget.noprogress-terminated: Session stopped after repeated rounds without progress.
native-budget.renew-confirmed: Working budget renewed — epoch {epoch}. Billing and usage counters keep accruing; only the working limits restarted.
native-budget.renew-unavailable: /renew is not available on the legacy loop engine — restart without --legacy-loop (or set terminal.native_agent: true) to use it.
native-budget.renewal-offer: {dimension} Continue with /renew (billing keeps counting; only the working limits restart) or close the session.
native-context.admission-denied: The conversation's context window is full even after compacting older messages — this turn cannot be sent as-is. Start a fresh context epoch (/renew) or shorten the request.
native-context.checkpoint_cadence: Execution budget checkpoint reached — saving progress before continuing.
native-context.checkpoint_token_pressure: Measured context pressure pushed this turn's context near its limit — saving a checkpoint before continuing.
native-context.compact.degraded: compaction degraded — the checkpoint could not be saved; epoch {epoch} kept
native-context.compact.unavailable: /compact is not available here — no scratch store on this engine
native-context.error_authority_unavailab: {code}: request measurement authority is unavailable — inspect /provider
native-context.error_overflow: {code}: request was not admitted because input context exceeds available capacity — inspect /context
native-context.lifecycle.operation_budge: operation: blocked — working budget exhausted (/renew to continue work budget)
native-context.lifecycle.operation_idle: operation: idle (no in-flight turn, compact, or reference program)
native-context.lifecycle.permission_pend: permission: pending approval on an issued request
native-context.lifecycle.user_idle: user idle: {seconds}s since last user activity (does not consume work wall budget)
native-context.lifecycle.user_idle_untra: user idle: not tracked yet (no user turn or compact in this session)
native-context.request.last: last actual request: {purpose} · {decision} · {tokens} tokens ({percent}% of that request window) · {quality}
native-context.request.unavailable: last actual request: no request measurement yet
native-context.runtime.comparison_aligne: selection matches last admitted measurement identity (not dispatch/response proof)
native-context.runtime.comparison_model_: selection differs from last admitted measurement — model mismatch
native-context.runtime.comparison_not_ad: comparison: not performed (last measurement was not admitted — no served-request claim)
native-context.runtime.comparison_pendin: comparison: pending (no REPL selection — cannot verify match)
native-context.runtime.comparison_provid: selection differs from last admitted measurement — provider mismatch
native-context.runtime.comparison_unknow: comparison: unknown (REPL model is provider default — exact model match cannot be verified)
native-context.runtime.inference_pending: last request measurement: none cached yet
native-context.slash.interim_budget: turn tool budget: {calls}/{callsLimit} calls · host asks left {requestsLeft}
native-context.slash.interim_deliverable: interim deliverable: {calls}/{callsLimit} tool calls · {elapsed}/{elapsedLimit} s since the last one · delivered {delivered} · host-requested {requested}
an interim answer is outstanding (host-requested, not yet delivered)
native-context.slash.interim_exhausted: the turn tool budget is spent; only an answer may follow
native-context.slash.interim_overdue: the interim answer is overdue: the model is still streaming, the host cannot cut a provider stream short
native-context.slash.preamble_budget: preamble: {tokens}/{limit} budget ({percent}% of window) · {tools} tool schemas
native-context.slash.preamble_floor_admi: preamble share exceeded, floor admitted; transcript and output reserves preserved
native-context.slash.reference_requests: child requests: {map} map · {reduce} reduce (ceiling {cap}) · usage {input} in / {output} out tokens
native-context.slash.refresh_planned: a compaction is planned for the next turn
native-context.slash.unavailable: /context is not available on this engine (legacy loop) — no context authority to read
native-context.slash.work_budget_epoch: working budget epoch: {epoch} (resets on /renew — not billing totals)
native-context.slash.work_budget_wall: active work time: {elapsed}s / {limit}s wall budget (not user idle TTL)
native-output.continuation-exhausted: Automatic continuation gave up after repeated attempts — the output ceiling kept cutting the answer short. This is an output-generation limit, not a full context window.
native.TOOL_RESULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXHAUS: This tool result did not fit the remaining context allocation for this turn. Other pending tool calls in the same batch may still run.
native.boot.config-invalid: native engine not started — project configuration is invalid. Fix .deckent/config.json and restart Deckent.
native.boot.legacy-host-fallback: No native transport is configured. Continuing on the legacy-host surface with {provider}. To use the native engine, configure native_provider and its required credential or endpoint, then restart Deckent; or use --legacy-loop to choose the legacy surface explicitly.
native.boot.legacy-host-surface: Terminal capability selected the legacy-host surface with {provider}. To use the native engine, restart Deckent in a supported interactive TTY with native_provider and its required credential or endpoint configured; or use --legacy-loop to choose this surface explicitly.
native.boot.legacy-host-unavailable: The legacy-host provider {provider} could not be initialized. Check its configuration and availability, then restart Deckent.
native.boot.legacy-model-default-unsuppo: The legacy-host surface has no persisted model-default setting. The model changed for this session only; no configuration was written.
native.boot.surface-unsupported: The native engine requires the interactive Ink Terminal surface. Restart in a supported TTY, or use --legacy-loop to choose the legacy-host surface explicitly.
native.checkpoint.degraded: Scratch checkpoint could not be saved; the session continues without checkpoint recovery.
native.checkpoint.deterministic: The model summary was unavailable. A checkpoint preserves the full transcript by content reference; it contains no generated summary.
native.checkpoint.pressure-suppressed: Context pressure reported again with nothing new since the last checkpoint — the current epoch is kept instead of re-checkpointing the same opening.
native.checkpoint.replay-served: Identical tool call served from the checkpoint trail — it already ran this turn and was not executed again.
native.checkpoint.trail.heading: Tool calls already executed this turn — an identical call is served from this trail, not re-run:
native.checkpoint.trail.last_assistant: Last visible assistant text before the checkpoint:
native.checkpoint.trail.omitted: {count} earlier entries omitted; the full trail is sha256:{digest}, readable with {tool}.
native.checkpoint.trail.read_hint: Bytes are addressed by sha256 digest only: read them with {tool} (ref = digest, offset/limit in bytes). Never read them by path.
native.checkpoint.trail.replay_note: served from checkpoint trail — this exact call already ran this turn; use the result above or call something different
native.context.effective: Context: configured {configured} · effective {effective} · native budget derived from {budgetSource}
native.context.restart_required: Context: configured {configured} · effective {effective} · restart required · native budget derived from {budgetSource}
native.context.unavailable: Context: configured {configured} · effective unavailable (live server metadata unavailable)
native.empty-visible-with-reasoning: The model spent its output budget on hidden reasoning without producing visible text yet — continuing automatically to recover a visible answer. This is an output issue, not a full context window.
native.interim_deliverable_failure_stop: {attempts} attempts against {target} failed — that line is closed; answering with what is known.
native.interim_deliverable_final: Tool budget for this turn is spent after {toolCalls} calls — answering with what is in hand.
native.interim_deliverable_overdue: The interim answer is {elapsed} s overdue; the model is still streaming.
native.interim_deliverable_required: interim answer requested — {toolCalls} tool calls / {elapsed} s since the last visible result; the assistant now reports known so far · remaining · next step, then continues
native.measurement_authority.reason.meas: latest measurement failed; conservative upper bound in use
native.measurement_authority.reason.unsu: hosted endpoint has no local tokenize routes
native.model_identity.unknown: model identity mismatch — "{model}" is not published by this endpoint; published IDs: {published}. Fix native_model to an exact published ID.
native.model_identity.unreachable: model identity for "{model}" could not be verified — endpoint /models unreachable ({detail}); the server may still be starting (cold start). The first turn may fail until it is ready — no silent fallback was applied.
native.output-ceiling-reached: The model hit its output token ceiling mid-answer — continuing generation automatically from where it stopped. This is an output limit, not a full context window.
native.permission.grant-failed: The tool permission grant could not be applied.
native.permission.hold: Tool permission requires an authorized decision.
native.permission.no-longer-current: This tool permission request is no longer current.
native.permission.terminal-unavailable: Terminal control could not be confirmed restored. This tool continuation is held; the recorded decision is preserved. Open a new terminal session to continue.
native.reasoning_exhausted: The retry also ended at the output ceiling ({ceiling} tokens) with ~{reasoningTokens} tokens of hidden reasoning and no visible text — the turn was ended. Lower execution_budget.native_agent.reasoning, set reasoning.mode to "off", or ask a narrower question.
native.reasoning_exhausted.retry-unadmis: The model spent its output ceiling ({ceiling} tokens) on ~{reasoningTokens} tokens of hidden reasoning with no visible text, and the raised ceiling ({raised} tokens) cannot fit the context window while preserving the preamble and transcript reserves — the turn was ended without a retry. Set reasoning.mode to "off", lower reasoning.exhaustedRetryBudgetTokens, or start a fresh context epoch (/renew).
native.reasoning_exhausted_output_ceilin: The model spent its whole output ceiling ({ceiling} tokens) on ~{reasoningTokens} tokens of hidden reasoning and produced no visible text — {action}. This is an output limit, not a full context window.
native.reference-descriptor-fallback: {n} reference(s) exceeded the measured budget; switched to tool-mediated partial reads.
native.reference.interim-skipped: No interim answer yet ({reason}); the reading is still in progress.
native.reference.unavailable: Reference analysis could not finish: {reason}. No complete analysis is claimed.
native.reference.usage-hold: The reading finished, but {count} interim request(s) never reported confirmed usage; the cost for those is not settled.
native.switch.model-authority-unavailabl: switch failed — the project model authority cannot be read safely; no provider call was made
native.switch.model-inactive: switch failed — model "{detail}" is inactive under the owner policy; activate it with deckent models activate
native.tool_result_withheld: result withheld from model context (full bytes in session store)
native.transport-failure: Connection to the provider dropped ({code}) — retried {retries} time(s) (transportRetry = {configured}) and failed again; the turn ended without a reply. Check that the endpoint is up and try again.
native.transport-failure.no-retry: Connection to the provider failed ({code}) during the {phase} phase and was not retried (a retry after the response started could duplicate output); the turn ended without a reply.
native.transport-failure.not-authorized: Connection to the provider dropped ({code}) and was not retried because execution_budget.native_agent.transportRetry is {configured}; the turn ended without a reply. Raise transportRetry (max 3) to allow bounded retries.
native.transport-failure.permanent: Connection to the provider failed ({code}) — this failure is not transient (certificate, DNS or an unknown cause), so it was not retried; the turn ended without a reply. Fix the endpoint/TLS configuration and try again.
native.turn_interrupted: interrupted after {toolCalls} tool calls / {elapsed} s — the partial output above is kept
native_permission.intent_always_conseque: persist this tool grant, including later resources
native_permission.intent_round_consequen: each remaining confirm-tier call listed above runs once without re-asking; always-tier calls still ask
native_permission.intent_session_consequ: this tool for the living session, including other resources
